verses.2: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.3: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
verses.4: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.5: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
verses.6: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.

verses.10: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into
verses.11: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
verses.12: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.13: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
